layout.name: Four Quads
layout.reason: 10 desks in two teams of 6 and 4, clusters of desks, screens meeting in the middle, off a street across the room. Work comes and goes by a post box and a stack of stock, and the courier calls. Lookups go to 2 bookshelves. The break end has coffee, kept away from the quiet desks. Loading Bay: industrial greys against the brick and the deep sage.
